# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source_1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source_2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source_3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source_4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source_5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source_6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
source_7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_7.csv", index_col=0)
source_8 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_8.csv", index_col=0)
source_9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION the four sources with the same schema (dimension tables)
union_dim = pd.concat([source_2, source_3, source_4, source_8], ignore_index=True)

# Join the unioned dimension table with all aspect tables on ROW_WID
# Start with union_dim as base
df = union_dim

# Join with Source0 (VISITS_NUM)
df = df.merge(source_0, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with Source1 (COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM)
df = df.merge(source_1, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with Source5 (KEYWORDS_NUM)
df = df.merge(source_5, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with Source6 (TECHSUPPORT_NUM)
df = df.merge(source_6, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with Source7 (INBOUND_CALLS_NUM)
df = df.merge(source_7, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with Source9 (INTERACTIONS_NUM)
df = df.merge(source_9, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# The target schema is only ['CANCEL_DT'], so select that column
# Keep all rows (including NaN) as target examples contain NaN in CANCEL_DT
result = df[["CANCEL_DT"]]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_26/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
